cleanup.meaning: Both exact owned PIDs absent; no broad kill used.

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable limitations, 10 exceptionally clear and comfortable across assessed use. Scores are holistic judgments of observed emulated interaction, not win grades or physical-device certification.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent, accessible short mission with effective feedback and assistance. Dark scenes, small labels and view changes demand inspection; sustained touch comfort remains unknown.
reasons.controls: MOVE plus FIRE drag, swipe turn, AIM and DASH all responded visibly. Tap aim helps acquisition. Zoom cover failure and armor-only burst preserved; no proven evade or uninterrupted rearming comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Three recoveries, coil status phases and defended upload provide clear progression. Manual patrol engagement worked. Strong route assistance and paused observations limit judgment of pacing, tension and continuous enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/orange palette, rain, wet ground, large title and restrained end screen support atmosphere. Blocky scene and heavy overhead geometry sometimes dominate view. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Route/approach labels, threat directions, memory checkmarks, map legend, automatic reload and upload percentages explain next actions. Fresh reset and terminal summaries are clear.
reasons.readability: Primary HUD health/ammo and objective labels are strong. Distant guards, small world signs and dark cover are harder to distinguish; stacked objective/threat overlays consume portrait space.

unassessed: KIT/tools, settings changes, recovered memory prose and other unsampled content

protocol.sourceAccess: Only helper --help read; no game source, tests, docs, prior review, recording, internal state or target metadata inspected. Own report and evidence filenames used for finalization.
protocol.touch: JSON-lines native touch, at most two contacts
protocol.observations: Every screenshot viewed in a separate image-view call before adaptive continuation; one new scene target per batch; no keyboard/mouse/evaluation/custom controller.
protocol.waits: Every requested wait <=12000ms; automatic boundaries inspected; shortened waits not treated as full duration.
